interpretation.handleZIssue: The actual react-flow__handle is 7.8x7.8 px (very small). The + extension handle (h-20 w-20 = 80x80) is much bigger and overlaps it. Drag from a position close to but not exactly on the handle hits the + extension bubble, which creates a new command node, NOT a connection line.
interpretation.connectionLineExistence: React Flow's standard .react-flow__connectionline (SVG path) appears DURING drag but disappears after pointerup if no valid drop target. The trace shows it briefly but V3 couldn't capture mid-drag due to 5s/pointermove driver pace.
interpretation.noFeedback: **No new connection was created** even when dragging onto the pre-existing video target (because that edge already exists). No error toast, no bounce-back animation — silent no-op.
interpretation.css_evidence: Connection line is SVG inside .react-flow__renderer. During drag, the line follows the pointer with bezier curve from source to pointer position. When pointerup on a valid target, the line is replaced by a real .react-flow__edge. When invalid, the line just disappears.
interpretation.v1Confirmation: V1 §9.3 listed '节点 → 节点 = 创建连线'. V3 confirms this is the only way to create connection; there's no menu-based connection.
